explication: Spegel is a stateless, cluster-local OCI registry mirror. A workload’s image pull reaches Spegel’s registry API, which serves content from the local containerd store when available and can obtain missing content from external registries or peers. The runtime also shares content availability through libp2p and exposes operational metrics and a web interface. The graph preserves these documented capabilities; implementation details for some unsampled modules are limited to source-index references, so uncertain links are omitted.
